summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would require flags flown, used or supplied by the Commonwealth to be made in Australia using materials that were also manufactured in Australia.
It would add this requirement to the Flags Act 1953 and define which flags and ensigns the Commonwealth's new manufacturing obligation would cover.
The requirement would cover flags and ensigns referred to or appointed under that Act, with commencement on a date to be set by proclamation.
changes: Section 7 would be reorganised into numbered subsections.
The expression designated flag would replace the existing longer description in section 7.
A new subsection would impose the Australian manufacture and materials requirement on the Commonwealth.
summary.affected: The Commonwealth, when flying, using or supplying covered flags, is affected.
